title: PA5 LED does not blink on Nucleo-F401
user_question: Builds and flashes fine, debugger shows the loop running, but the LED on PA5 stays off.

reference_context.title: STM32F4 Reference Manual RM0090 (ST)
reference_context.document: RM0090 Reference manual: STM32F405/415, STM32F407/417, STM32F427/437 and STM32F429/439 advanced Arm-based 32-bit MCUs
reference_context.section: 7.3.10 RCC AHB1 peripheral clock enable register (RCC_AHB1ENR) [STM32F405xx/07xx and STM32F415xx/17xx]
reference_context.snippet: Bit 0 GPIOAEN: IO port A clock enable Set and cleared by software. 0: IO port A clock disabled 1: IO port A clock enabled

expected.root_cause: The GPIOA peripheral clock is never enabled in RCC, so HAL_GPIO_Init's register writes are ignored.
